# Matkakoti Kieppi

> A small, affordable guesthouse (matkakoti) in the centre of Kuhmo, Kainuu, Finland. 14 cosy private rooms for one or two people, with an extra bed available and one room with a double bed. Towels and bed linen, WiFi, a fully fitted shared guest kitchen and dining area, free parking and an electric car heater spot are included. Rooms lock and have their own washbasin and mirror; toilets and showers are shared on the corridor. Evening sauna on request. Breakfast mainly from Midsummer to the end of July; at other times it can be ordered for more than five people. Offers for companies and groups, and long-term stays are possible.

- Address: Vienantie 3, 88900 Kuhmo, Finland
- Phone: +358 40 199 8190
- Email: mmsarkkinen@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/matkakotikieppi
- Nearby (straight line): Juminkeko Kalevala centre 200 m, town-centre restaurants 500 m, Atalante library 600 m, Ruukinranta beach and the swimming hall 800 m, Petola nature centre 3.3 km, Kalevala sports centre ski trails 3.4 km, Winter War museum 3.8 km.
- Kuhmo Chamber Music festival is held every July (2026: 12–25 July).
